cohort: 242 pregnant women (121 with FGM and 121 controls matched for age, ethnicity, parity, and gestation)
finding: FGM was not associated with an increased incidence of adverse obstetric and fetal morbidity or mortality in this UK cohort.
mod_finding: While there was a significant increase in the use of episiotomy in the FGM group, there were no other significant differences in obstetric and neonatal outcomes between women with and without FGM.
